title: Destiny 2 – Official PC Launch Trailer
source_rights_note: Bungie, Inc. copyrighted footage, used under Bungie's fan-content policy, which permits non-commercial fan creations. PROVENANCE IS STRONG: this is the official 'Destiny 2' channel's own upload (UC52XYgEExV9VG6Rt-6vnzVA), not a fan compilation -- it is the first-generation publisher master for the 2017 PC launch live-action campaign, including the dance sequence and the 'AVAILABLE ON PC OCTOBER 24' card that the Brutal Draconis compilation (yt_destiny_all_live_action_trailers) carries at one extra generation. Top rung is format 315: 3840x2160 VP9 at 20,780 kb/s, 60 fps, and that 4K is GENUINE -- a 4K frame downscaled to 1080p and back returns at 50.7 dB against 46.2 dB for a known-native official 4K reference and 55.4 dB for the fan compilation's upscaled 2160p. Prefer this source over the compilation wherever the two overlap (issues #55, #86). This index stores only metadata and timestamps, not the footage.
